La Lancha fires best at dawn, when the offshore wind is still light and the lineup is empty. It is a world-class left point break five minutes from the villa — the kind of wave people book flights for.

Here are the five breaks within reach of Villas Sempre Avanti:

La Lancha — World-class left point near Punta de Mita. Fast, hollow, and consistent when the swell is running.

El Anclote — A mellow right-hander tucked into the bay. Great for longboards, great for the days you want a session without the intensity.

Sayulita Main Break — Two minutes into town and you are paddling out. Works for all levels, with the whole energy of a surf town around you.

Stinky's — Just north of Sayulita, sandy bottom, forgiving waves. The right call for anyone just getting started.

Burros — Multiple peaks, consistent, room to spread out. The reliable option when the other breaks are not cooperating.

Victor, your guide and instructor, meets you at the villa, picks the break for the day based on swell and your level, and has you in the water within the hour. Beginner lessons on the beach break. Advanced sessions at La Lancha. Private boat safaris when the conditions call for it.

This is what a surf trip looks like when you stop compromising on where you sleep.
